name: Iterant Public API
description:
The Iterant public API: read a brand's pages, page opportunities, reports and AI visibility, and start Iterant's agent on a page. Guides: https://iterant.ai/docs/developers/rest-api

**Authentication.** Send `Authorization: Bearer itr_...`, an API key an organization admin mints at Settings > Developers.

**Rate limits.** 600 requests per minute per key, and 30 task starts per minute. Responses carry the IETF `RateLimit-Limit`, `RateLimit-Remaining`, `RateLimit-Reset` and `RateLimit-Policy` fields. A `429` carries `Retry-After` in seconds. Requests without a valid key are limited to 60 per minute per client IP.

**Idempotency.** `POST .../tasks/` takes an `Idempotency-Key` header. For 24 hours, a retry with the same key and body returns the first task instead of starting a second.

**Versioning and deprecation.** The version is in the path: `/api/v1/`. Breaking changes ship under a new version. A deprecated version keeps working for at least 6 months after the announcement, and its responses carry `Deprecation` and `Sunset` headers (RFC 9745, RFC 8594). Nothing is deprecated today. Policy: https://iterant.ai/docs/developers/rest-api#versioning-and-deprecation
